environment.data: Synthetic test library; normal user profile and data untouched

nativeExecution.confirmationHandling: Only the confirmation service responses were controlled; the native deletion command, permissions, selection, and database operations ran unchanged.

limitations: Keyboard events were dispatched programmatically to the live grid; no physical keyboard or manual visual interaction was required.
Confirmation and read-only alert responses were controlled through a temporary Services.prompt facade and restored afterward; native dialog visual appearance was not assessed.
Runtime verification was performed on macOS with Zotero 9.0.6; cross-platform shortcut behavior is covered by portable tests.
